verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is event-driven, so automatic reactions are possible by writing code: subscriptions react to published topic messages (ros2-docs-20), content-filtering subscriptions narrow which events reach a callback (ros2-docs-33), and a node can process data as it arrives and dispatch long-running actions (ros2-docs-23, ros2-docs-24). However, there is no evidence of a declarative way to define rules; any event-to-action logic must be hand-coded in nodes and callbacks. Missing for 10: a declarative rule/trigger definition mechanism, documentation of event-to-action automation as a feature, and independent hands-on corroboration.
